# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 20 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 20 | **Condition:** heavily damaged/fragmentary

---

**20:1** [...] You have opened [...] my heart [...] to Your teaching [...]

**20:2** [...] I have hearkened to Your truth [...] and You have [...] my ear [...]

**20:3** [...] the mysteries of Your wonders You have disclosed to me [...]

**20:4** [...] discernment [...] Your holy spirit [...]

**20:5** [...] You have opened a font of knowledge for all the discerning,

**20:6** a wellspring of strength for all who are blameless in their conduct, a source [...]

**20:7** [...] they drink [...] from the spirit of holiness [...] for the glory of [...]

**20:8** [...] with all the epochs of eternity and the appointed seasons [...]

**20:9** [...] You have set before me [...] truth and justice [...]

**20:10** [...] lovingkindness to deliver me and mercy [...]

**20:11** [...] discernment [...] the mysteries of Your wonders [...] and who [...]

**20:12** [...] who is the creature of clay in Your sight? What is he [...]

**20:13** [...] You have inscribed the law upon my heart and [...] understanding [...]

**20:14** [...] a spirit of knowledge in every work of truth [...]

**20:15** [...] to walk in humility [...] and to cherish lovingkindness [...]

**20:16** [...] a humbled heart [...] the spirit of holiness [...]

**20:17** [...] You have made firm [...] my steps upon the paths of righteousness [...]

**20:18** [...] upon the level ground [...] to walk before You at the boundary of [...]

**20:19** [...] the way of life [...] the path of peace without ceasing [...]

**20:20** [...] who is the creature of clay before [...] You have inscribed [...]

**20:21** [...] upon the tablets of [...] the teaching of life [...]

**20:22** [...] You have ordained for me [...] truth [...]

**20:23** [...] the ordinances of [...] to walk in all [...]

**20:24** [...] not to depart from any of Your words [...]

**20:25** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and justice [...]

**20:26** [...] the holy spirit upon Your servant [...]

**20:27** [...] to stand [...] in Your presence forever [...]

**20:28** [...] for You have instructed me [...] the design of Your heart [...]

**20:29** [...] in Your truth You have [...] upheld me [...]

**20:30** [...] Your lovingkindness [...] is my joy [...]

**20:31** [...] pardon and the abundance of mercies [...] in Your righteous decree [...]

**20:32** [...] a spirit of knowledge [...] truth and justice [...] the holy spirit [...]

**20:33** [...] You have fashioned [...] in Your truth [...]

**20:34** [...] the works of Your hands [...] for Your glory [...]

**20:35** [...] all their host [...] the spirits of [...]

**20:36** [...] the holy ones [...] the everlasting ones [...] in exultation [...]

**20:37** [...] before You [...] forever and ever [...].

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 20 is extensively damaged. The discernible themes include divine pedagogy, the indwelling of the holy spirit, walking in righteousness, and the inscription of Torah upon the heart (cf. Jer 31:33). "Font of knowledge" follows standard rendering of maqor.*
